The *Saccasaññakattheraapadāna* (Tha-Ap 215) is a verse text located in the Therāpadāna section of the Pali Canon [SuttaCentral]. As an apadāna of an elder monk (*thera*), the poem recounts the past meritorious deeds and subsequent spiritual attainments of the elder Saccasaññaka. SuttaCentral records translations of the text in five languages [SuttaCentral].
